title: Projektetage Tile Fullscreen
description: Fix split tile fullscreen on projektetage catalogue slides: pressing fullscreen on a tile does not expand it to slide fullscreen.
summary: Split catalogue tiles entered slide fullscreen on the wrapper but the inner figure tile frame kept its grid-relative inline size. Added fullscreen CSS (same stretch rules as canvas-framed) and excluded fullscreen from pinned state. Regression test for split-tile fullscreen toggle.
